description: Find the Amazon product for a barcode: UPC, EAN, ISBN or GTIN

country.description: Amazon marketplace as an ISO country code. GB is amazon.co.uk. Default US.

identifier.description: UPC (12 digits), EAN/GTIN (8, 13 or 14 digits) or ISBN-10/13. Hyphens and spaces are ignored.

name: lookup_product
